meta.source_title: Traveling performance evaluation of wheeled rover climbing various soil slopes (Sutoh, Nagatani, Yoshida; Proceedings of the 2012 JSME Conference on Robotics and Mechatronics, 1A2-L06, in Japanese)
meta.vehicle: two wheeled test rover, mass ballasted to 4.0 kg for every wheel set, axle distance 400 mm, wheel speed 2.50 rpm
meta.soil: Toyoura sand (JIS R 5200), cohesionless, nearly uniform grain size
meta.comparability_note: Panel (a), 5 mm lugs, 6 lugs = filled square. 8, 12, 16 deg: square fully visible. 20 deg: square body visible with the apex of the 3 lug triangle above it. 0 and 4 deg: the square sits in a stack of filled markers (circle below it, open marker above); centre taken from its flat top edge and the 17 px side, so these two are inferred from partial outlines. 24 deg: left out, the square merges with the top frame and its lower edge is hidden by the open square of 48 lugs. Error bars not transcribed.
